Type: rustic stoneware plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant on a table, shelf or sill; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, rustic, Japandi
Materials: speckled stoneware, partly white glazed, raw clay base
Colors: warm white, tan brown
Shape: cylindrical pot with narrower raw clay base, rows of dashes and dots in tribal pattern, compact
Feel: earthy, warm, handmade
Goes with: rattan, jute, natural wood, terracotta; bohemian or Japandi rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Emerick Rustic Stoneware Planter Pot - 6 Inch, Brown and White
product.description: The natural earth tones in this stoneware planter will match well with any interior design. With or without a plant, this beautiful stoneware pot will add a stylish touch to your office or any room in your home. It can fit nicely on a windowsill or desktop. Exterior: 6.69" Diameter x 6.3"H; Interior: 6.125" Diameter x 5.625"H 100% stoneware For small plants Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth Designed for indoor or artificial plants; no drainage hole
